name: cloud-affine
description: Cloud AFFiNE — our own signed build of AFFiNE (the local-first notes/whiteboard app), vendored at ac_cloud-affine/ as owned code. DE-CLOUDED (#469): no AFFiNE server, no Firebase/telemetry, no AI chat, no EE-licensed code. The one feature added over upstream is opening files from emulated storage (/storage/emulated/0/...) reached via the fleet rule about EAR discipline — see the ship workflow and testers.
_doc_vendored_engine: Byte-identical to ac_cloud-affine/build.sh, enforced by cloud-android-ship-repo-workflow-engine.sh parity check so the shipped engine and the vendored copy cannot drift.

android._doc_application_id: FLIPPED (#495): this app now IS Cloud Notes, replacing Markor (formerly ac_cloud-notes, now deleted). #469 shipped it alongside the live Markor under com.diegonmarcos.affine on purpose, to avoid ripping out a live app and a 9000-file vendor in one commit; #495 is the flip that was always the documented next step. namespace stays app.affine.pro — it is the upstream Kotlin/TS package, never shipped as install identity, and renaming it across the vendored tree would be a large, pointless diff.
android._doc_version: 164/0.27.5 (#495). version_code must exceed ac_cloud-notes's last shipped 163 or the fleet updater's downgrade guard refuses to install this as an update over the device's existing Cloud Notes (observed live: 'stale candidate for notes: versionCode 1 is OLDER than the installed 163') — the vendored AFFiNE Gradle defaults to versionCode 1 with no wiring to this file, which is the defect #495 fixes below. version_name FOLLOWS AFFINE'S OWN UPSTREAM VERSIONING (package.json version at the pinned revision) rather than continuing Markor's Apache-tag-mirroring scheme (163/2.16.1 mirrored upstream Markor tag v2.16.1) — the two apps have unrelated release trains and there is nothing for a post-flip Cloud Notes to mirror from Markor any more. Read into Gradle by app/build.gradle via JsonSlurper (see that file) — this is the ONE declaration; nothing else states these numbers.

upstream._doc: Full clone vendored as owned code (no .git, no upstream remote). MIT except packages/backend + packages/common/native — BOTH PRUNED (EE licence forbids copying/distributing). Proven at the Cargo level in ac_cloud-affine/VENDORING-LICENCE.md and enforced by the licence-boundary-guard on every push.

tests._doc: Shell testers under ac_cloud-affine/test/ that prove licence-cleanliness and app identity WITHOUT a build. Read by cloud-android-test-engine.sh::tests.shell.
